categories.main_business_segments: Novogene Co., Ltd. primarily operates in gene sequencing services, including life science basic research services, medical research and technical services, and library sequencing platform services. The company also develops and sells clinical gene testing medical devices, focusing on tumor, genetic, and infectious disease testing. Its services cover genomics, proteomics, metabolomics, and multi-omics integrated solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes high-throughput sequencing technologies including second-generation (NGS) and third-generation sequencing platforms such as Illumina NovaSeq X Plus, PacBio Revio, and Oxford Nanopore Technologies. It has developed automated and intelligent production lines (Falcon and Falcon II) for sequencing and sample preparation, and proprietary bioinformatics analysis software and cloud platforms. The company also advances multi-omics integration, single-cell sequencing, spatial transcriptomics, and de novo sequencing technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Novogene serves global research universities, scientific research institutes, hospitals, pharmaceutical R&D enterprises, and agricultural companies. Its customer base includes over 7,300 clients across approximately 90 countries and regions, covering academic research, clinical research, and industrial applications. Key markets include China, North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global presence with laboratories and subsidiaries in China (Beijing, Tianjin, Shanghai, Guangzhou), the United States, United Kingdom, Singapore, Germany, Japan, and the Netherlands. It serves customers across six continents and about 90 countries, with significant revenue growth in Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, and overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Novogene operates primarily in the midstream segment of the gene sequencing supply chain, providing sequencing services and bioinformatics analysis. It procures sequencing instruments and reagents from upstream suppliers such as Illumina and Thermo Fisher and delivers sequencing data and analysis to downstream customers in research and clinical fields.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in sequencing technologies, automation, and multi-omics integration. R&D priorities include developing new sequencing products, improving bioinformatics automation, expanding clinical applications (tumor, genetic, infectious diseases), and enhancing intelligent production systems. It invests heavily in de novo sequencing, molecular breeding, transcriptomics, epigenomics, metagenomics, and single-cell sequencing technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Novogene generates revenue mainly through direct sales of gene sequencing services, including life science research, medical research, and sequencing platform services. It also earns income from sales of clinical gene testing kits and related reagents and consumables. The company uses a direct sales model supported by technical and customer service teams, with some overseas distribution partnerships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Novogene is a leading gene sequencing service provider in China and globally, competing with companies like BGI Genomics, Berry Genomics, Burning Rock, and Macrogen. It focuses on foundational research sequencing services, differentiating itself through advanced technology platforms, global localized labs, and comprehensive multi-omics solutions. It holds a strong market position with extensive academic and clinical collaborations.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Novogene reported revenues of approximately RMB 2.0 billion, a 3.97% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 178 million, a 0.47% increase. The company’s total assets reached RMB 3.59 billion, growing 17.92%, with net assets increasing 25.07%. Overseas revenue grew by 22.06%, reflecting successful global expansion. R&D investment was RMB 124 million, accounting for 6.2% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Novogene emphasizes high-throughput, high-quality, and efficient gene sequencing services supported by advanced automation and intelligent production systems. Its global localized laboratory network ensures rapid, stable delivery tailored to regional needs. The company offers comprehensive multi-omics integrated solutions and proprietary bioinformatics platforms, providing customers with precise, scalable, and innovative genomic research and clinical applications. Its strong R&D capabilities and extensive patent portfolio underpin its competitive edge.
